name: get_entry_value_via_argument_pointer
description: Takes an entry pointer from an address register and returns zero when the entry type is excluded. Otherwise it returns a cached field if set, or else reads a field from the parent structure that the entry links to.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:3:03DE

description: Repeatedly allocates an entry for each item in a null-terminated list, stores each name into it and links it into the structure, and returns the last result. It returns zero when no entry can be allocated.

name: update_link_after_call
description: Calls a routine with a pointer taken from a linked entry and a global pointer, then updates a link field in the structure and calls two further routines.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:024C
name: release_or_advance_list_entry
description: Checks whether the current list entry is at an end of the list. If so it runs a closing sequence, otherwise it advances the list pointer and runs an update sequence. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:02A6
name: update_link_field_from_entry
description: Calls a routine with a pointer read from the structure, then replaces a link field in the structure with the value stored behind that link. It then calls two further routines.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:02E8
name: append_new_list_entry_and_update
description: Sets a global flag and, when the list is not empty, calls two routines with the current entry data. It then allocates an entry and a 128-byte block, stores the block pointer in the entry, links the entry in and updates the list pointer.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:0398
name: advance_list_with_link_update
description: Sets a global flag, then either runs a closing sequence on the argument or calls two routines and chooses a new link value from the list before running further calls. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:040C
name: reselect_list_entry_after_call
description: Saves the value behind the current list link, calls a routine on that entry, and reselects the list end when the list is exhausted. The result is stored as the new current link.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:0452
name: execute_sequential_callbacks
description: Calls one routine, then calls two more routines with fields read from the structure at offsets 46 and 62. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:047A
name: build_pointer_array_from_list
description: When a flag is set, counts the entries in the list and allocates an array of four bytes per entry, storing its pointer in the structure. If the list is empty the array pointer is cleared, and a value from the allocation steps is returned.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:0498
name: allocate_pointer_array_for_entries
description: Counts the list entries, allocates an array of four bytes per entry and stores its pointer in the structure, clearing the pointer when the list is empty. It returns a status value from the allocation step.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:04BA
name: fill_pointer_array_for_entries
description: Calls a routine with an entry pointer, counts the list entries and allocates a four-bytes-per-entry array, then copies a block into it. It returns one on success and zero when the allocation fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:04E0
name: build_entry_pointer_array
description: Counts the entries in a list, allocates a four-bytes-per-entry array and stores its pointer in the structure, then fills the array with pointers to the entries. It returns zero when the allocation fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:0508
name: copy_entries_into_pointer_array
description: Copies a block into the pointer array, then walks the list and stores a value for each entry in the array. It returns one when the list ends.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:0530
name: store_entry_values_in_array
description: Walks the list from the current entry, storing a value for each entry into the pointer array and copying a block with each stored value. It stops when an allocation fails.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:13:0568
name: process_entries_into_array
description: Repeatedly copies a block for each entry in the list into the pointer array, advancing through the list until its end. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:19:0000

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:19:001C
name: forward_library_call_90
description: Calls a routine in the library through a jump entry at a fixed negative offset from the library base pointer stored in the data area. It passes no arguments of its own and returns nothing.

name: populate_entry_table_by_type
description: Chooses a table of fixed entries from the entry type and calls one routine for each entry with fixed numeric values and a reference to a shared text, or with a field of the structure for some entries. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:04EE
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:04F4
name: allocate_entry_buffers
description: Allocates four buffers of fixed sizes and one sized from a stored value. When the first set is present, it allocates a second set with further fixed sizes.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:0594
name: finalise_entry_buffers_by_type
description: Calls three allocation or setup routines and stores the result of a fourth in the argument, returning zero when any is missing. Otherwise it runs one of several sequences chosen by the entry type and returns the type value.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:0602
name: run_type_specific_call_sequence
description: Runs a different number of routine calls depending on the entry type, from two calls up to five, and returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:07AA
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:07B4
name: lookup_optional_stored_buffer
description: Clears or fills a stored buffer depending on a stored size, then runs a lookup routine and returns zero when it reports not-found, otherwise its value.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:07D2
name: lookup_stored_buffer_value
description: Calls a routine with a stored buffer and size, then returns its result, or zero when that result is minus one.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:0814
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:081A
name: check_four_fixed_fields_lookup
description: Sets four fixed values into structure fields unless the entry type is four, then runs a chain of four lookups that report failure with minus one.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:0880
name: check_three_indirect_lookups
description: Runs three indirect lookups and returns one when none gives a not-found value of minus one, otherwise zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:089A
name: check_two_indirect_lookups
description: Runs two indirect lookups and returns one when neither gives a not-found value of minus one, otherwise zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:08B4
name: check_indirect_lookup_found
description: Runs one indirect lookup and returns whether it found a value rather than minus one.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:7:08D0
name: stub_return_one
description: Returns one with no other work.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:0000
name: walk_entry_chain_with_bit_mask
description: Loops over entries, calling a routine on each non-empty one and returning zero if that call fails. When an entry is empty it makes a bit-mask call instead.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:004E
name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero with no other work.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:0056
name: dispatch_by_entry_size_code
description: Chooses an action from a numeric code stored at offset 20 of the structure. Two particular codes return the result of a routine or zero, a small range calls one routine, and otherwise it makes a common call and returns one.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:0082
name: forward_library_call_450
description: Calls a routine in the library through a jump entry at a fixed negative offset from the library base pointer stored in the data area, then calls one further routine and returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:0090
name: call_two_routines_return_zero
description: Calls two routines with no arguments and returns zero.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:009C
name: execute_two_calls
description: Calls two routines with no arguments and returns one.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:00B8
name: execute_multiple_callbacks
description: Calls one routine three times with the argument, then once more unless the entry type is one. It then calls a routine with a field from the structure and a constant, and finally calls a routine with the argument and one. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:0114
name: format_protection_flag_strings
description: Computes four flag bits from a stored value and calls a formatting routine once per bit, each time with a matching label such as archived, deleteable, readable or writeable. Each call passes a global pointer and the bit as a boolean.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:0196
name: format_flag_text_with_negation
description: Builds a format template in a local buffer, choosing one of two prefix bytes and two strings depending on a flag argument. It passes these to a formatting routine with a negation pattern, so the output shows a negated flag name.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:9:01E6
name: format_string_arguments
description: Builds a temporary buffer from a stored value and a global string, passes it to a formatting routine, and then calls two further routines. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0000
name: count_zero_terminated_length
description: Counts the bytes at a base address until a zero byte is reached and returns the count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:000A
name: count_bytes_to_terminator
description: Advances an index from an incoming value until a zero byte is found at that position, and returns the index.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0016
name: copy_cstring_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated byte string from a source to a destination, writing the terminator too.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0024
name: copy_fixed_length_bytes
description: Copies a given number of bytes from one buffer to another, one byte at a time.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0034
name: copy_memory_block
description: Copies a counted block of bytes from a source address to a destination address one byte at a time.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:003E
name: compare_strings_until_mismatch
description: Advances both strings while their characters match and neither has reached its terminator, then returns whether the final characters are equal.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0048
name: compare_c_strings_equal
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings from their current positions and returns whether their final characters are equal.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0068
name: get_string_length_with_terminator
description: Counts the bytes in a zero-terminated string, including the terminator, and returns that count.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:007C
name: execute_library_operations
description: Calls a routine on the fifth argument and keeps its result, then makes three calls through a library-base field in the structure, one of them with the fourth argument reduced by ten. It returns nothing.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:00D2
name: call_string_formatter
description: Fills a 12-byte local buffer from a global text using the fifth argument, then passes the buffer and the other arguments to another routine.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:011A
name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies a length-prefixed string, where the first byte gives the count, into a destination buffer and appends a zero terminator.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0138
name: copy_counted_bytes_with_terminator
description: Copies a counted run of bytes from a source to a destination and writes a zero terminator after them.

key: f-117a stealth fighter (1993)(microprose)[cr dc](disk 1 of 3)[a]/F-117A Stealth Fighter (1993)(MicroProse)[cr DC](Disk 1 of 3)[a].adf:LIBS/info.library:11:0154
name: fill_two_record_structures
description: Stores a sequence of parameter values into two structures, clearing the unused fields and adjusting one coordinate by minus ten, then calls routines and returns a boolean.

description: Calls one routine with a field read from the structure at offset 62 and returns one.

name: execute_library_calls
description: Calls three routines through a library-base field in the structure, passing a value adjusted by minus ten in one of them, and returns nothing.
